reviews.text: The staff is caring and attentive.

On behalf of Freddy thank you for the great experience! 3,5 hours was over in a flip., and looking how he came out he had a good and relaxing time! We are very happy with the result and stunning groom! Love it!

Amazing service! The staff were incredibly friendly, caring, and loving with my rescue dog. She had a lot of tangles and had never been groomed before, and they completely transformed her. She came back looking beautiful and unbelievably soft. So happy with the result!

I had such a positive experience bringing my cat here for grooming today. Everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming. A special thank you to Tatiana at reception who was lovely and helpful and to the gentleman with glasses who groomed my cat. He was so sweet with him and very professional which made me feel completely comfortable leaving my cat in his care.

It is definitely on the pricier side but the quality of service and how genuinely nice the staff were made it a really positive experience. My cat came back looking great and very well taken care of. Thank you! 🐱

Great experience for our dog getting groomed at Pamppy. We were especially impressed with the level of detail of consultation with us, and even more so with how fantastic our dog looked after and also how much our dog loved the experience (and she is not normally a fan of groomers). I would not hesitate to recommend this groomer! They are a great find :)

The best salon we've been to in Malti's five years of life, even though we've lived in Cyprus, Dubai, Georgia, and Russia.

No one has ever cut my hair as beautifully and beautifully as you! And with such care, thank you so much!

My pups had the best experience at Pamppy! The team took the time to get to know both of my dogs and really listened to what I wanted from their groom. They were incredibly attentive, kept me updated, and even gave me an exact time they’d be ready.

The results were amazing, the best haircut they’ve ever had! Their coats are so soft and shiny, and the cut is exactly what I asked for. I couldn’t be happier with the care and attention they received. We’ll definitely be back!
Fantastic!
Amazing 10/10!
There are kind people who love dogs working there.
Very skillful team who treat my toy poodle with so much care and kindness!

So grateful to have Pamppy for our Cavapoo puppy Bhalu!! They are caring, kind and very patient. For the little context: Bhalu had a lot of matts under his long hair. After months of being on the lookout for a caring groomer and hearing horror stories about other dog’s hair, a neighbour told us about how great Pamppy is. When I arrived at the salon, the team took the time to explain the process of getting matts entangled. They weren’t sure if they could keep a good length of hair (we’ve heard that usually other groomers would have shaved him without trying to entangle first) but they took their time and did an amazing job. When my husband arrived to pick him up, Bhalu didn’t want to leave the salon! He clearly feels secure and loved there. We will not let anyone but the Pamppy team taking care of Bhalu’s hair 🥹💜 thank you for everything!
Absolutely amazing place for cats and the owners!Very friendly staff and great care about animals
I simply loved it. The teeth cleaning surpassed by far all my expectations. Her teeth are super clean now. Impressive!

This is my dog Milo's go to grooming place. It's a super clean and professional facility. They do a fantastic job each time. Highly recommend for anyone who wants amazing pampering and grooming for their pets.

Update: We now take all our 3 dogs here. Team at Pamppy have bee consistently excellent with their professionalism and also how sweet and caring they are to the animals. 10/10

I had such a wonderful experience here! From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed, which immediately set the tone. I came in for a manicure and pedicure while my dog, Cookie, had a grooming appointment — and everything was absolutely perfect.
The manicure and pedicure were amazing, done with great care and attention to detail. They even offered a delicious chocolate and drinks, which was such a lovely touch. The staff were incredibly attentive and made sure I was comfortable the entire time.
At the same time, Cookie was being groomed, and I was really impressed with how gentle and caring they were throughout the process. They clearly love what they do and treat the pets with so much kindness. After the grooming, they checked multiple times to make sure everything was perfect, which I really appreciated.
Everyone was extremely kind, warm, and genuinely sweet. You can tell they truly care about both their clients and their furry friends. Highly recommended — we will definitely be coming back!
We had our Maltipoo's teeth cleaned today. Very happy with the result, everything is completely white again. Friendly welcome and Bobby came walking out cheerfully afterwards.
We went there was a last min and we had the appoiment same day , really friendly , with a nice but nice store and profesional people
Love pammpy they are super! Will continue to come back very patient with my doggie that doesn't like grooming ay all
Great dog groomers! Are dogs are treated well and come out looking and smelling great
My dog is usually very nervous when I pick her up from the groomer, but this time she was happy and relaxed 😌 And so beautiful, I think the most pretty cut she ever got ✨💇‍♀️🐩 …

Amazing experience! The team was so helpful and kind. I brought my ragdoll kitten, and they were incredibly gentle with her. She looks great now, and I learned so many useful tips and advice. I highly recommend them! 🙂 …

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Have been a client for years, and it keeps amazing me! Great service! I just wanted to thank the whole team, but specially Stasy, for the excellent work done with Argos. As a senior golden retriever, he demands attention and care, and the team provided all that!

He came back home so fluffy and clean, and the hygienic trimming is absolutely spotless. You can really see the care and attention to detail.

Truly well done! and thanks again!
Very friendly and skilled dog trimmers. We just brought out puppy Amy there and she got excellent service. We are very happy with everything
Friendly and patient staff. Stacy was very positive and patient with my dog. She did a wonderful job.

Dear Carlos, thank you for your rating. We reached out to you directly the same day, as we prefer to discuss feedback one-to-one and understand how we can improve personally. Unfortunately, we didn’t receive a response, but we remain open to private dialogue at any time 🐾  …
Amazing experience. Honestly groomers. Definitely recommended.
Expensive

The only perfect place in the whole country to groom your furry friend. Specialists are very skilled , I trust them my dog every time and was never disappointed.
Special thanks to the administrators - the service is the best. You always have a tea or other drinks , you can wait in the cosy chair or just chat with them. Love the place !
Best dog salon in Amsterdam. They take extra good care of your dog and recommend other services without being pushy, they really just have the best for your animal in mind! 5 out of 5 paws

Pamppy is the best trimming company I've been to. After many mishaps with other grooming services I can say that this grooming company is by far the best. They take care in listening to what you want for your pet and can provide some suggestions where needed. They are wonderful with pets and my dog was absolutely in love with her grooming experience.
I can definitely recommend this place especially for new pet owners or puppies.

Veda and I came here for the first time today, and what a wonderful salon this is. The women who work here were truly friendly and relaxed, which had a really positive effect on my dog. She looked absolutely beautiful afterwards and smelled amazing. She was also completely happy! We’ll gladly come back next time! :)

I cannot recommend Pampy enough. I came in for a BIAB manicure and ended up having one of the best “self-and-dog care” afternoons I’ve had in Amsterdam.

While I got a perfect BIAB set—clean, glossy, shaped exactly how I wanted—I also got to watch them treat my Goldendoodle like royalty. They didn’t rush anything. They were gentle, patient, and genuinely skilled. The full spa and haircut they gave him was next-level; he walked out looking like he belonged in a luxury pet campaign.

The atmosphere is warm, the staff actually care, and the quality speaks for itself. If you want beautiful nails and a place where your dog gets pampered properly, this is it.

11/10. Will absolutely come back.
The salon is super nice and caring! They took so much time and had great patience with my 4-month-old puppy. We did the hygiene treatment. The result looks amazing — we’ll definitely be coming back!

I took my Australian Cobberdog Zaza to this trimsalon and was so impressed! The team was super friendly and gentle — they made Zaza feel relaxed right away. Her coat looks amazing, soft and perfectly trimmed. The salon is clean and welcoming, and you can tell they really care about the dogs. I have already planned our next appointment. Highly reccomend it! 🐶✨
Great, first visit today. Just nails. It was done very professionally. They took their time and were very hygienic. My dog ​​was nervous, but she came back quite calm. So happy!

Amazing grooming. I really appreciated the groomer, Jackie, walking towards Theo, my dog, she said he’s older, he needs a different kind of care. She already knew without me saying a word. Theo is nearly 12 and needs calm and someone to love on him a little bit when grooming. I really trust she did that with him. He was very happy and looks incredible 💜

Expensive but they take good care of the dogs. And the grooming is top class.
Extremely friendly and helpful staff.
Parking is a bit of a problem because it's in abery narrow street next to the canal.

Brought our poodle Enzo there for a full grooming and was amazed how delicate and attentive the staff is. Enzo seemed to enjoy his time there and came back so fresh and beautiful ❣️ thank you so much, we will be back!

Such a great experience in the salon! We went for dental polishing , Buddy got the best assessment and expertise, and a treatment which was more suitable for for him, which is highly appreciated.

Ladies are very sweet, caring, professional and welcoming. Definitely coming back for frequent visits when it’s needed!

Highly recommend! Now curious to add my own treatment while my doggy is being taken care w!

Very happy with the care and attention my dog Charlie got at PAMPPY! I really appreciated how everything was explained to me, step by step, and how they take everything into consideration and recommend the perfect treatment for each dog. Charlie was so happy when I returned to pick her up and she looked all cute, clean and fluffy! Thank you PAMPPY! Charlie will be back
I took Lotje, 14, to have her teeth cleaned, and she now has sparkling smiles again without anesthesia. Highly recommended!

Was absolutely lovely! Beautiful space, the workers are very professional and know how to get all type of dogs, the receptionist was very lovely and friendly! i definitely would come back and recommend it
I bring my cocker spaniel, Bobbie, here. Very nice people. Always satisfied.

I have had a wonderful experience at Pamppy’s!!
Lilly, our rescue dog was very anxious at the beginning but with the love, care and patience of the people of Pamppy she felt comfortable soon. It was a whole transformation but she is looking so much better and feeling better. Because of the shelter her fur became in very bad condition. The people of Pamppy helped Lilly getting into a happy dog again ❤️

I had a great experience with Pamppy dog washing and grooming services! Communication was fast and smooth — they responded quickly, offered available time slots right away, sent a reminder before the appointment, asked for the dog profile and were super kind and understanding even when we arrived a bit late.

The grooming itself was fantastic. The dog looked absolutely stunning afterwards — such a big difference compared to before, even paws were carefully groomed! All the knots were gone, his fur looked beautiful and well cared for, and the haircut was very pretty. They were very friendly and paid great attention to detail, from the wash to nail trimming and teeth cleaning.

Really appreciated how thoughtful and professional they were. I’ll definitely recommend this place for those, looking for amazing services for their 4-legged friends

Few weeks ago we had our first visit and were incredibly impressed! Our groomer was amazing with our doodle as our dog hates grooming —so patient, kind, and clearly experienced. He gave our pup the perfect cut (definitely a doodle cut, not a poodle look!), exactly how we asked. We’re so glad we found him and will definitely be back!

Five stars from me and Leni!

I can’t thank you enough for the amazing job you did on Leni. She looks absolutely gorgeous — I never knew my own dog could look this stunning! The care and attention you gave really means a lot. We’re so happy and will definitely be back. Highly recommended!

This is my absolute favourite place in Amsterdam to bring my dog. The team is amazing — I can always leave my pup with peace of mind, knowing she’ll be well taken care of. They are a bit on the pricey side, but it’s absolutely worth it. They always do a full check and give helpful feedback if any further steps are needed.

They’re amazing! They really care about your dog and pay attention to every detail. It’s not just a simple wash and cut—the grooming and teeth cleaning were great.
I live in The Hague and wasn’t happy with the groomers I tried, so I’m really glad I made the trip.  Highly recommended!
Excellent service and they handle my dog with great care and patience for her grooming session❤️

Got a very big l, strong and of course stubborn beagle that HATES water or loud noises… or any type of grooming honestly…😅 still they made it possible to clean him, clip and polish his nails and brush his teeth. We picked him up and he was not scared and greeted us with a waggling tail and his loud howls. They were honest that he was not the easiest dog to groom and couldn’t wash his head, but the fact that they were even able to do the things they did without leaving him scared or traumatised made me so happy. Will be making a new appointment soon!

I can’t recommend Pamppy enough! They always take amazing care of our dog, and the grooming is always done with great attention to detail. The groomers are not only incredibly friendly but also very professional. Our dog had a bad experience at a previous groomer and used to be nervous about grooming, but at Pamppy, she walks in happily every time—ready for her spa day!

Wonderful experience at pamppy! My little pup had broken his leg so they helped him with a hygiene clean whilst he is healing. They were really gentle and careful with him and he was in great spirits when I picked him up which shows how well they looked after him. Also he looked so lovely - they really helped him to look and feel his best. Really recommend this place!
A great experience for both me and my dog - it was his first time being groomed ever, and he left the place happy and cheerful, so there is no better recommendation than that!
Great service, our dog Toni is happy there and we are always happy with the results.

Super nice salon and people. A case of you get what you pay for. High quality and amazing standards. Our cat isn’t stressed out after a visit and the employees of Pamppy take their time and take care of your pet. Couldn’t be happier

On the advice of a colleague, we went to Pamppy with our Floortje last week. I can only say WOW to everything (from the introduction over the phone, the treatment, the explanation, etc.). Floortje can't wait because she gets to go again in 8 weeks (LOL).
always friendly and manage to cut the nails if a difficult customer :) (and bring him back in one piece :)

I just visited for the first time with my dog, Chip. I am incredibly happy with the way his hair was trimmed, his nails neatly filed, his ears cleaned, and his teeth treated. But above all, I am very happy with the way he came out of the grooming salon: with a wagging tail and a blissful little skip that he kept up for at least fifteen minutes after leaving the salon. He clearly had a wonderful time, which is by no means a given at all dog grooming salons. They advertise as a dog spa, and that is clearly how Chip experienced it too 😄 I will definitely be back!

The staff were very kind and friendly, but I have a Spanish Water Dog who needs his dreadlocks done from the roots, and that wasn't possible. My dog ​​came back super clean, but the truth is that the dreadlocks weren't done properly 🫠 I'm very sorry because I actually paid €200 for his grooming and they returned him almost the same as when he came into the salon 😒.
Great experience! For me and the dog!

So far, I’ve been to Pamppy twice for grooming and once for teeth cleaning with my dog Mila. They’re always doing a great job and even when there is an issue present, they resolve it immediately and truly care about the well-being of the dogs. I can highly recommend their 5-star service 👍🏻 …

The people who work here aren't groomers.. they are artists!! My toy poodle has been to many groomers both in NL and abroad, but Pamppy is by far the best of them all. So much attention to detail and effort to making my dog feel comfortable. Love it!
My pup is surely looking fabulous after his hygiene beauty treatment! The treatment of the staff was efficient and really friendly and kind. I recommend it!

They are the best! My puppy had some bad experiences at the vet and I was a bit scared how he would do at the groomer. They listened to my concerns and took super amazing care of my puppy. He came out happy every time!
We always have a lovely experience at Pamppy! The staff are professional and wonderful. They take such good care of our mini labradoodle :)

Highly recommend PAMPPY team! Mr Juan enjoys his spa moments and always looks amazing, squeaky clean , glowing fur and most importantly with a happy tail! The team makes me feel confident that he is well taken care of during his stay there!

Hello there my fellow four legged friends! I got a amazing place I have to tell you about!

Ask your moms and dads to take you to Pamppy, it's divine! I feel so much better there and after my visit my mom tells me that I smell like an apricot.

Everyone wants to cuddle me and I get extra rewards afterwards, last time I even got a toy.

My hairdresser is the best! I think I am a little in love with her 🐶 I would like to go there every week, but my mom won't let me even though she loves it here too!
She always gets a delicious cappuccino or champagne and there is a big jar of treats. If she feels fancy she can even do her nails at the same time... 😀😀😀 My 12 points go to pamppy!!

Lots of love Bacio and my mum
Nails were uncut, ear hairs were not removed, not very effortful considering the premium price level of 115 euros for being trimmed to 8 mm and only having the paws and face styled.
Always a super experience with Pamppy! We struggle with getting our cat’s nails properly trimmed but they do such a good job with our cat every single time.

They are fantastic! I live in Utrecht, but I came to Amsterdam on purpose because even before I met them, they inspired me with so much confidence. After two years of living in the Netherlands, I have never taken my dog ​​to a groomer because I don't trust them. I finally found someone I can trust blindly. He had his teeth cleaned excellently by a real professional. The icing on the cake is the fantastic and super sweet Tania. Thank you so much!

I am so happy with my dog’s haircut! The person who did the grooming was incredibly kind and treated my dog with so much care. They welcomed us very warmly, and because my dog reacts to other dogs, they even opened the salon for us on a Sunday. Everything went perfectly, and the haircut looks amazing. We can’t wait for our next appointment!

They took care of every detail and listened to my indicators for my pet that is older and to shower it must be taken special care.  They understood my concern for my pet and the result was great.  my pet came out of the hairdresser happy . They are the best in Amsterdam.

Eddy had his teeth professionally cleaned, and the service from scheduling to the appointment itself was perfect. The result is fantastic; we'll definitely come back next time we're on holiday near Amsterdam.

Thank you so much! 🙏🏼
My dog's teeth came out super clean after the treatment! He was finished very quickly and was running around happily off-leash when we picked him up. A pleasant experience.
Highly recommend this salon for great service and results, both for you and your little furry friends!

I’m traveling through Europe with my dog, and finding a good groomer along the way has been challenging. Pamppy Dog was a true gem! They treated my pup with such care, and he came out looking and feeling fantastic. It’s wonderful to find a place where they understand the needs of a dog on the road. Highly recommend!
Very careful and professional staff, the pets are always happy and relaxed. Totally recommended!

Super friendly, cozy place with amazing professionals and great service. Our 16-year old dog can be considered a difficult client and she was taken care of so carefully and patiently that she felt at ease throughout the visit. I couldn’t have asked for better care. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly dedicated and compassionate team! 🧡

Pamppy Dog was incredible with my pup! He came out looking fantastic and was so calm afterward. The staff clearly cares about the animals, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Highly recommend!

Pamppy Dog did a real disservice to my dog. He’s calm in almost every setting, even with vets, but whatever happened here left him scared. The groomer yanked at his ears with such force I could hear him crying from a distance. Since then, he’s visibly stressed just passing by the building, pulling on the leash to avoid it altogether. I can’t recommend this groomer if you want your pet handled with the care they deserve. I don’t take this lightly—this was a traumatic experience for my dog, and I wouldn’t trust this groomer with any pet. If I could give zero stars, I would.
We are very satisfied with the grooming and cleaning, totally recommend ❤️
I took my cat there to be groomed! I'm happy with the result and with how she was treated ^^

Pamppy groomed my golden retriever and did an incredible job! He's a little afraid of the blow dryers and Pamppy was able to use a mix of more distant dryers and towel drying to get him dry and keep him calm. When finished he was beautifully trimmed, smelling wonderful, soft and TIRED OUT 😂😂😂 …

The staff was incredibly friendly and made sure my pup felt comfortable throughout the process. The grooming itself was done with great care and attention to detail—my puppy looks absolutely adorable! You can tell they really take pride in their work. The service was prompt, professional, and worth every penny. I’ll definitely be coming back for future grooming sessions. Highly recommend this place to any pet owners looking for a trustworthy grooming service!

I've been taking my dog, Charlie, to Pamppy since he was just 5 months old, and I couldn't be happier with the service. The whole team at Pamppy is so caring and accommodating. They always make sure Charlie feels comfortable and at ease. …
Best service.. lovely staff and caring
Amazing groomer, my dog is super fussy and they've gone over the top to accommodate him.
